commands.help: Control-test BOF: duplicates the winlogon token to get SYSTEM. Requires an admin token - EXPECTED TO FAIL for standard users (use it to prove host hardening, not as an elevation tool)
commands.long_help: CS-BOFs get-system: finds winlogon.exe, enables SeDebug, duplicates its token and starts cmd.exe with it. Requires SeDebugPrivilege - a standard user does not have it, so this is designed as a control test on hardened hosts: expect an access/error on standard-user beacons, success on elevated admin beacons.
